origin: a prose rewrite of the todo-app PRD (tests/fixtures/spec/todo-app/PRD.md): the same 8 requirements, no IDs, no MUST. 'complete' shares a paragraph with 'create', as a real author would write it: one block (D3), so known_limit

requirements.start: People should be able to add a task by typing a title
A task they have finished can be ticked off
Deleting a task has to really remove it
Whatever changes on one device should show up on the others
It has to feel instant: every tap or click should finish within 200 milliseconds
Nothing may be lost if the connection drops.
Working with no network at all matters too.

not_requirements: Sharing a list with other people is out of scope for the first release.
Our team keeps losing track of small jobs
